spells.title: Molang Expressions
spells.description: Harnessing Bedrock's query language to create data-driven, dynamic animation logic.

spells.description: Multi-phase boss AI with dynamic attack patterns, phase transitions, and environmental awareness.

spells.title: Flying Entities
spells.description: Custom aerial movement systems with pathfinding, hover logic, and smooth directional control.

spells.title: Scripting API
spells.description: Extending Bedrock's capabilities with GameTest and Script API to build systems impossible in JSON alone.

spells.title: Biome Generation
spells.description: Crafting custom biomes with unique surface rules, climate settings, and mob spawning.

spells.title: Features & Feature Rules
spells.description: Procedurally placing structures, ore veins, and decorators using Bedrock's feature rule system.

spells.title: Custom Blocks
spells.description: Building fully custom blocks with unique geometry, states, events, and crafting recipes.

spells.title: Server UI Menus
spells.description: Dynamic server-side form systems with branching logic, player data, and real-time state.

spells.title: Weapon Attachables
spells.description: Custom weapon models with first-person animations, enchant glints, and attachment geometry.

spells.title: Sprite Animations
spells.description: Frame-by-frame sprite sheets with precise timing and expressive character motion.

spells.title: Persona Content
spells.description: Marketplace-grade persona pieces following Mojang's style guide and technical constraints.

spells.title: Texture Variants
spells.description: Creating cohesive variant sets — damage states, seasonal skins, color palettes — from a single base.

spells.description: Physically-based rendering maps (normal, heightmap, metalness) for Bedrock's deferred pipeline.

spells.title: Vanilla Art Direction

spells.title: Particle Effects
